annotations.title: Run Pre-Flight CAD Doctor & Instant Tier Quote

description: Run a read-only Pre-Flight CAD Doctor inspection on a PCB design (.kicad_pcb, .dsn, .ato, .tsx, or sample_id) and compute a binding NRE price quote without launching a billable synthesis job. Call this tool before calligraphy_compile_board to validate board outline integrity, footprint overlap rules, pad/layer counts, effective SKU tier, and exact USD/USDC pricing. Provide sample_id ('2l_rp2040', '2l_stickhub', '4l_carrier'), raw pcb_text, or base64 upload_b64. Returns JSON with effective_sku, base_price_usd, final_price_usd, layer_count, p_total, p_unrouted, and agentic_crypto_payment; if MISSING_EDGE_CUTS_OUTLINE or OVERLAPPING_FOOTPRINTS_DETECTED is raised, fix the CAD geometry first.

customer_email.description: Engineering contact email address used to check active 30-day ECO re-spin licenses and regional compliance. Example: 'hw@company.io'.

filename.description: Original CAD filename with extension (.kicad_pcb, .dsn, or .zip) used to select the parser. Example: 'sensor_node.kicad_pcb'.

include_eco_pass.description: When true, adds the optional +50% 30-Day Unlimited ECO Re-Spin License surcharge for 2-layer Maker Studio boards.

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 CAD source text (.kicad_pcb S-expression, Specctra .dsn, atopile .ato, or tscircuit .tsx) to inspect and quote.

preserve_existing_copper.description: When true, locks and preserves existing pre-routed copper traces and vias while surgically routing only unrouted or target_nets openings during Rev-B ECO layout updates.

project_path.description: Local workstation path to a .kicad_pcb or .dsn file (supported in local STDIO mode) or a built-in sample_id.

requested_sku.description: Requested service tier SKU: 'vibe_micro' ($149 2L <=150 pads), 'basic_2l' ($295 2L <=250 pads), 'dfm_fix' (post-route DFM repair), 'route_3d' ($995 4L commercial), or 'turnkey_full' ($1,495).

rush_delivery.description: When true, adds the optional +35% Priority Enclave Rush turnaround surcharge (<45-minute priority queue).

sample_id.description: Built-in demo board identifier ('2l_rp2040', '2l_stickhub', or '4l_carrier') for instant evaluation when no local CAD file is supplied.

target_nets.description: Optional list of specific net names (e.g., ['/I2C_SDA', '/I2C_SCL', 'USB_DP', 'USB_DM']) for surgical Rev-B ECO partial reroutes; empty array routes all unrouted nets.

upload_b64.description: Standard Base64-encoded binary payload of a .kicad_pcb, .dsn, or multi-file .zip project archive.
